title: Abyss Brain Proposal v1
description: Candidate evolution proposal drafted by Brain Agent via LLM. Candidate material only — requires Owner approval before entering the governance chain.

proposal_type.description: simplify=remove/simplify existing; add=new capability; expand=extend existing; fix=repair broken; maintain=upkeep; no_action=system stable.

evaluated_simplify_alternative.description: Did Brain evaluate whether a simplification alternative could achieve the same goal?

simplify_alternative_found.description: Was a viable simplification alternative identified?

simplify_alternative_description.description: Description of the simplification alternative, if found.

chosen_approach.description: The approach chosen after anti-entropy evaluation.

justification.description: Why this approach was chosen. If add/expand was chosen over a found simplify alternative, this must explain why simplification was insufficient.

rationale.description: Why this proposal is needed, grounded in system state evidence.

target_area.description: Which part of the system this proposal targets (e.g. brain_agent, outbox, memory_layer, governance).

proposed_changes.description: Concrete description of proposed changes. Each item should be a specific, actionable statement.

system_assessment.description: Key findings from the system context that motivated this proposal.

next_step.description: Concrete instruction for the Owner to formally enter the governance chain.

boundary.description: Hard boundary statement. Must state that this is candidate material only.
